text: I'm a childminder and have a 6 year old boy staying over tonight, his parents can't be reached and I'm in a real state about getting this wrong. He's been off colour since yesterday and miserable. How much Calpol can I give him, or is ibuprofen better? I don't want to overdose him. I've checked his skin, there's no rash anywhere, and I pressed a glass on a couple of little marks on his arm and they faded straight away.
